headline: Dry and mild today, rain arrives tonight

sections.lead: Last dry-ish day before Thanksgiving-week rain settles in.
items: Today: cloudy and mild, 44°F now, high 57, no rain until this evening (then 7-13%).
Rain builds overnight: 55% after midnight, about 0.2".
Wed partly sunny 61/48, Thanksgiving Thu cloudy 59/48, Fri-Sat 56-57 dry.
First real storm line Sunday: 75% rain, gusty south wind near 24 mph.
If anything lives outside, bring it in or cover it today before tonight's rain.

sections.lead: The full moon finishes its peak this morning, and today is the warmest sky of your week.
items: Plain read: people and comfort are front and center today, and steady follow-through still pays. Keep replies cool and checked before sending.

Warmest window: Sun trine your natal Venus is exact today (0.1°), with Venus still sitting on your natal Moon (0.6°). Great day for the people stuff: holiday plans, checking in on someone, easy kindnesses.
Full moon wrap-up: the moon peaks in Gemini this morning (moonset 7:18 AM), lighting your communication axis. Anything unresolved from yesterday wants a clean word today.
Careful pen: Mercury opposite your Ascendant (1.3°) and squaring your natal Mars (2.6°). Words can come out sharper than intended. Draft, breathe, then send.
Steady hands: Saturn still trines your natal Sun (2.0°). Paperwork and follow-through energy holds.
Summary: warm heart, sharp pen, steady hands. How to use it: do the people stuff first, save hot replies for after coffee.
Details: Moon Gemini 2.4, Sun Sag 2.9, full 100%; Venus Libra 26.4; Mercury Scorpio 13.2; Saturn R Aries 11.1.
0 new construction-dispatch leads. 16th construction-only run.
LinkedIn blank again this morning; Indeed hit its login wall; ZipRecruiter showed repeats only (Neonline SFO, Fast Delivery Hayward, AT Towing).
Tracker holds 49 leads awaiting your Apply / Not-for-me.
Antioch High's basketball team rolled El Camino 71-24 Monday night, now 3-0.
Oakland police shot and killed a man armed with a replica gun Monday.
New El Niño coverage warns a 'Super El Niño' could hit the Bay Area this winter; sandbag locations are listed city by city.
Nothing new in the application mailbox.
Easy win: grocery run today. Dry and 50s all day, the last easy window before Thanksgiving.

Top: 1) groceries for Thursday. 2) DE 2501: yesterday's mail-by date passed; if the envelope didn't go out, mail it this week anyway, late beats never. 3) cover or bring in anything outside before tonight's rain.
Rest: nothing on your calendar; the 10am/3pm/5pm/6pm/7pm runs handle themselves.
Tony's and family calendars are both quiet today. Quiet Tuesday before the holiday.
